# Cncf Tikv Reviewer

Review TiKV using its official documentation and repository in the App Definition and Development / Database category. A distributed transactional key-value database. Based on the design of Google Spanner and HBase, but simpler to manage and without dependencies on any distributed filesystem

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
